name: WebChoreArena
summary: Apache-2.0 benchmark of 532 tedious web-chore tasks built on the WebArena sites, for evaluating browsing agents.
description: Research benchmark (repo WebChoreArena/WebChoreArena; not archived; created 2025-05-13; last pushed 2026-07-09; not presented as a brand-new 2026 launch). Root LICENSE is Apache-2.0. Project page https://webchorearena.github.io/ and arXiv 2506.01952 (both HTTP 200 on 2026-11-13). README and the homepage describe 532 curated tasks that extend WebArena toward labor-intensive chores, grouped as massive-memory, calculation, and long-term-memory tasks, on the four existing WebArena simulation websites. Running the benchmark requires a separately deployed WebArena environment and the resets described in the README, including before cross-site tasks. README evaluation examples use model API keys (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Gemini are named); no keys were supplied and no evaluator was started. Upstream WebArena components keep their own terms. Agent runs can change the simulated sites — treat them as potentially destructive evaluation environments.

agent_access.notes: Open-source benchmark on GitHub. Official evaluation needs a WebArena deployment and model API keys; none were used here.

maintainer: WebChoreArena authors / The University of Tokyo
